Hero_Desc_Elena:
Mayor of the elven city, Monatium.
A mech-magic engineer who has great pride in her research and inventions.
Outwardly, she tries to maintain a good relationship with other races...
but it's hard to trust her completely since elves usually lie to further their own agendas.
Album_Hate_Elena: Reviewing inventions. Intranet pages that take over 3 seconds to load.
Album_Hobby_Elena: Creating drones to handle hobbies on her behalf.
Album_Elena1: The mayor of the elven city and the authority on mech-magic engineering. Elena's knowledge in engineering is unrivaled, but this elf's inventions always seem to come with fatal flaws.
Album_Elena2: Back when the elves settled in Elias Forest, Elena was just your typical scientist. When there was nothing in the forest, she was irate that her E-pad couldn't find a Wi-Fi signal. She then built a power network and intranet using three million potatoes in just two days, leaving the elves to suffer from food shortages for some time.
Album_Elena3: Elena has incredible focus, which is both her strength and her weakness. Once she gets absorbed into something, she completely ignores everything else around her. Her pride in her work is so great, she often disregards the opinions of others.
Album_Elena4: Except with a few exceptions, the elves are not on friendly terms with the denizens of Elias Forest. This attitude is largely influenced by Elena, who, after becoming the mayor, advised the city's entire population not to get too attached to those who originally lived there. The more roots are placed in Elias Forest, the harder it is to return to your hometown. Or so they say.
Album_Elena5: While Elena may seem to treat other with contempt, but if you get to know her, she's not as bad of an elf as you might think. She just doesn't easily get attach to others, just like the policies she implements.
Album_Elena6: Despite her efforts, Elena acknowledges she was unable to prevent the closer ties between the elves and Elias Forest. Her biggest regret is not building a wall around the city in its early days...
Album_Elena7: Elena always thought about returning to her home planet, but now, she says she no longer obsesses over it. Perhaps after all this time, she's finally looking around at her surroundings, and Elias has found a permanent place in her heart.
